A job, and someone who does it: say who they are, as in on jest lekarzem.
Opens when you learn kim and four jobs, in chapter 5.
Who is it? Finish the sentence.
After jest, a job takes the instrumental: %1$s, not %2$s.
A verb you know: sort it into its group by how ja and ty end, as in znam, znasz or piszę, piszesz.
Opens when you learn four verbs of two groups, in chapter 6.
Which group is it? Think of how ja and ty end.
A hobby acted out in a picture: name it in Polish, as in jeździć na rowerze.
Opens when you learn four hobbies, in chapter 6.
Two words side by side: opposites or not? As many as you can before the time runs out.
Opens when you learn three pairs of opposites, such as nowy and stary.
Tap the word for the marked picture
Type the word for the marked picture
Hear a number and type it.
Opens when you learn four numbers.
Type the three numbers you hear
Type what the sum you hear comes to
Type what this sum comes to
Hear a price at the kiosk and pay it exactly, coin by coin.
Opens when you learn złoty, grosz and kosztuje, in chapter 7.
Listen to the price and pay it exactly
Tap coins to put them on the counter
Numbers up to a thousand are called: tick them on your card.
Opens when you learn the hundreds, in chapter 7.
Tick the number you hear on your card
Tick this number on your card
A dish is ordered: put its foods on the plate.
Opens when you learn four dishes with z, in chapter 8.
Listen to the order and put it on the plate
Put this order on the plate
Tap the foods below to put them on the plate
Hear a shopping list and fill the basket: dwie gruszki, trzy banany.
Opens when you learn jedna, dwie and four things to buy, in chapter 9.
Listen to the list and fill the basket
Tap the stall below to put things in the basket
Nabiał, pieczywo or słodycze? Put each product in its supermarket aisle, before the time runs out.
Opens when you learn three supermarket aisles and six products for them, in chapter 9.
You are the waiter. Hear each guest order, dla mnie żurek, a dla mnie to samo, and write it on your pad.
Opens when you learn dla mnie, to samo, a and six dishes, in chapter 10.
Listen to the table and write each guest\'s dish
Lubię kawę, nie lubię kawy. Pick the right way to say no, before the time runs out.
Opens when you learn six sentences and how to say them with nie, in chapter 10.
%1$s (%2$s) After nie, the thing takes the genitive.
Your family on a tree. Say who each person is to you, mój wujek, moja ciocia, or find them.
Opens when you learn the family, from dziadek to kuzynka, in chapter 11.
Who is the person marked ? to you?
Tap this person on your family tree
7:30 is rano, 23:00 is wieczorem. Say when in the day each time is, before the time runs out.
Opens when you learn four times of day, such as rano and w nocy, in chapter 11.
When in the day is it?
A clock face, and the time in Polish: pięć po ósmej, wpół do dziewiątej, za kwadrans dziewiąta. Say it, or find the clock.
Opens when you learn four hours, such as pierwsza and druga, in chapter 12.
Tap the clock that shows this time
Your week\'s plans, W piątek o dwudziestej: impreza. Put each in the diary on its day, at its time.
Opens when you learn the days of the week and the hours, in chapter 12.
Tap the day of this plan
A short story in the past, Najpierw wstałam o siódmej. Potem umyłam zęby. Put its pictures in order.
Opens when you learn the words of a story, such as najpierw, potem and wstałam, in chapter 13.
Tap the pictures in the story\'s order
A sentence in the past, and who said it: a man, a woman, or a group. The ending tells: byłem, byłam, byliśmy, byłyśmy.
Opens when you learn what a man and a woman say in the past, byłem and byłam, in chapter 13.
A group with a man in it
A little map and the way to a place, Proszę iść prosto, potem skręcić w lewo. Find where it takes you.
Opens when you learn prosto, w lewo and w prawo and the places of a city, in chapter 14.
Where do the directions take you?
↑ You start here, facing the map
A sentence, Kocham tatę. Say it shorter with go, ją, je or ich: Kocham go.
Opens when you learn go, ją, je and ich, the words for him, her and them, in chapter 14.
Which word takes the place of the marked one?
What is in it, ___ coli. Find what it comes in: puszka coli, a can of cola.
Opens when you learn puszka, butelka, słoik and karton and what goes in them, in chapter 15.
Count the pictures and pick the words: dwie butelki, but pięć butelek.
Opens when you learn to count containers, dwa kartony and pięć kartonów, in chapter 15.
How do you say how many there are?
Hear or read tomorrow\'s forecast and make its card: the weather and the temperature.
Opens when you learn the weather and the forecast, będzie padać and pięć stopni poniżej zera, in chapter 16.
Listen to the forecast and make its card.
Read the forecast and make its card.
Tap the weather below to put it here.
Find the hidden words in the grid of letters: the months and the seasons.
Opens when you learn six of the months and the seasons, in chapter 16.
Find each word: tap its first letter, then its last.
Fill in the table of the pronouns: komu? mi, z kim? ze mną, o kim? o nim.
Opens when you learn four of ze mną, z tobą, z nim and the rest, in chapter 10. Chapter 17 adds komu?, o kim? and dla kogo?
Tap the word for the empty square.
Hear or read where a thing is, Lampa stoi na biurku, and put it there. The room fills up as you go.
Opens when you learn six places of a room, łóżko, szafa, biurko and the rest, and a few things to put on them, in chapter 18.
Where does it go? Tap the place.
Does it stand, lie or hang? Fill in Obraz ___ na ścianie with stoi, leży or wisi.
Opens when you learn stoi, leży and wisi and four sentences of the room, in chapter 18. Stoją, leżą and wiszą come in with them.
Does it stand, lie or hang? Tap the verb.
Someone is looking for a flat or a room. Read three adverts and pick the one that fits.
Opens when you learn the words of three hunts, kawalerka, od podwórka, z łazienką and the rest, in chapter 19.
A city, a sea or a range of mountains is named. Tap where in Poland it lies.
Opens when you learn four places and where they lie, Gdańsk, na północy and the rest, in chapter 20.
Where in Poland is it? Tap the part of the map.
A page of the calendar shows a holiday and its date. Tap how you say when it is.
Opens when you learn four holidays and their dates, pierwszego czerwca and the rest, in chapter 21.
When is it? Tap how you say the date.
Tap the letters in order to spell the word.
Opens when you learn four words to spell.
Tap the letters to spell the word
Listen to the letters, and spell the word
Match or no match? As many as you can before the time runs out.
Opens when you learn six words.
Formal, informal or to anyone? Sort phrases by who you say them to, before the time runs out.
Opens when you learn six phrases the book marks O, N or U.
Who do you say it to?
You say %1$s to a pan or a pani
People introduce themselves. Listen or read, then fill in a form for each of them.
Opens when you can understand three people saying where they are from, where they live, their phone number and why they learn Polish.
Listen and fill in the form
